notes.title: Game Update | May 2025
notes.content:
The current update contains the following fixes and additions.

Fixed errors in the development of states.
Errors in large battles of the code, many units are involved.
Fixed errors in battle tactics and display of naval units
Fixed an error in the selection of technologies by a foreign state
Fixed the problem of upgrading units for Indians
Added a new system for upgrading units for Indians and small nations, now they periodically update and upgrade their units (for example, an Indian with a bow into an Indian with a gun) and add new ones. Thus, the army becomes stronger and harder to capture in the middle and end of the game.
Fixed an error in the location of armies in some battles in the taiga (where there are a lot of trees)
Fixed crashes after the battle due to the size of the armies.

Fixed crashes after the battle due to the fact that not all of the enemy's army was defeated. Now it is possible to re-battle with the remaining troops.
Fixed multiple shots if you quickly press the button.
Fixes displaying texts in the UI
When you hover over the mouse, resources and money are taken away, which show how much the work will cost.
Reworked the system of income from investments. Now the buyer of a cell will always receive income from it if this product was sold. Income will be reduced if the cell is captured by another great power.
If you capture a region, foreign units now become visible. Previously, this led to a bug when it was impossible to move to a cell because it was occupied by a foreign unit. Foreign units display a foreign flag.
Fixed income from trade transactions.
Added display of flags near sold goods if the goods belong to foreign investors.
Additional entry in the journal when selling goods of foreign investors.
Fixed modernization of the iron and steel factory. Previously not upgraded over 16.
Bug fixed
Fix purchased treasures (Diamonds, gold) do not bring income to the owner of the cell (investor).
The flag of the great power that bought the land will disappear when it is destroyed. The rights to the land will go to the new great power that controls this region.
